name: assessing-suicide-risk
description: Supports clinicians and chart or quality reviewers with suicide risk screening, assessment documentation and safety planning. Checks the screen against the tool's own instructions and population (ASQ, C-SSRS screener, PHQ-9 item 9 limits, age 12 and youth rules), builds a SAFE-T structured assessment record (ideation, plan, intent, behavior, risk and protective factors, firearm and lethal means access, collateral), drafts a formulation scaffold for the clinician's own risk determination, reviews a collaborative Stanley-Brown safety plan, lethal means counseling, discharge follow-up and 988 crisis resources, and maps documentation to Joint Commission NPG.08.01.01 (hospitals, 2026) or NPSG.15.01.01 (behavioral health). Flags copied-forward assessments, score-only risk levels and negative screens read as no risk. Use for suicide risk assessment notes, C-SSRS or ASQ review, safety plans, or suicide prevention chart audits. Drafts only; never a final risk level, an order, or a record of care that did not occur.
